blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Davao City Mayor Sebastian “Baste” Duterte arrived at the Senate on Tuesday after he was subpoenaed by the Senate impeachment court to testify during Vice President Sara Duterte’s impeachment trial. The House prosecution panel is anticipated to present Mayor Duterte as a witness on his sister’s alleged unexplained and undisclosed wealth. According to a previous witness from the Philippine Government Electronic Procurement System, two Davao Region government offices, and the local government unit of Davao awarded a total of 49 food service contracts amounting to over P35 million to Gencorp Industries Inc. from July 2022 to June 2026.
